activities.title: 7 ежедневных заданий
activities.conditionHtml:
1. 29.10: купите Aftermarket Car.
  2. 30.10: выполните 5 Clean Racing Skills.
  3. 31.10: завершите Cross Country Race.
  4. 01.11: получите не менее 1 звезды на Speed Zones.
  5. 02.11: завершите заезд на любом Drag Meet.
  6. 03.11: выполните 5 Wreckage Skills.
  7. 04.11: получите не менее 1 звезды на Danger Signs.
Награда: 5 000 CR за задание.
activities.howHtml: Выполните указанное условие в соответствующий день.

activity_02_daily.title: 7 Daily Challenges
activity_02_daily.conditionHtml:
1. Oct 29: purchase an Aftermarket Car.
  2. Oct 30: earn 5 Clean Racing Skills.
  3. Oct 31: complete a Cross Country Race.
  4. Nov 1: earn at least 1 star from Speed Zones.
  5. Nov 2: complete a run at any Drag Meet.
  6. Nov 3: earn 5 Wreckage Skills.
  7. Nov 4: earn at least 1 star from Danger Signs.
Reward: 5,000 CR per challenge.
activity_02_daily.howHtml: Complete the listed objective on its scheduled day.
